name: nvm
description: Node Version Manager - POSIX-compliant bash script to manage multiple active node.js versions.
one_liner: A free little script that lets a developer switch between different versions of Node.js on their own computer.
buyer: Nobody pays for this directly; it's a free utility every JavaScript developer already installs for themselves.
business_use_cases: A developer switches Node versions per project so an old client project and a new one don't conflict on the same machine.
A bootcamp or training course has students install it on day one so everyone's environment matches, with zero licensing cost.
A freelance developer uses it to quickly match whatever Node version a client's legacy project requires.

money_ideas.idea: None realistic: it's foundational open-source developer tooling with no natural toll booth.

steal_this: Nothing to build here. This is plumbing, not a product; the honest weekend project is to use it, not monetize it.
